kind: Exact native functional proof and operation census; no local elapsed-time comparison or speed claim
contract: Only the existing privatelyOwnedMemo/no supplied pcbConnectivityMap/no supplied connMap/canUseExpectedPortsMemo admission enables component-once expansion.

Native classes, collection methods, numeric intrinsics and callback-free finite plain input are the existing guarded module-load contract; this slice introduces no new eligibility or public trust flag.

The fresh native physical connectivity map is immutable during this BFS. An actual string physical-net label has exactly the same complete native getAllTracesConnectedToTrace member array for every trace in that component.

The first physical component query remains native; subsequent same-string-label queries are omitted only after its members have all been enqueued. Non-string labels and all declined/supplied-map invocations retain every original query.
Pad adjacency runs for every visited trace, including bridges between distinct physical components and distinct logical nets.
The final original pcbTraces.filter determines circuit order, duplicate trace inclusion and actual trace object aliases; its array remains cached under every included trace ID.
Primitive memo intern/get/hit/miss/eviction and polygon/expected-port memo operations are unchanged. No worker or protocol change is made.
closureProof: Let R(t) be the native physical-component member set returned for trace t, and P(t) its touched-pad neighbors. Native BFS finds the least set closed under R and P containing its start trace.
For equal native string labels, R(t) is identical. The first expansion queues every R member. Repeating that expansion adds no member that has not already been queued or visited.
Every newly reached trace still expands P(t), so a pad bridge can reach a new physical label, which is then expanded in full. Removing redundant R expansions preserves the least fixed point.
Internal pending-stack order may differ; no custom callbacks are eligible. The unchanged final filter restores the original returned order and references.

instructions: Use an isolated checkout of the commit containing this proof and install its pinned dependencies. Source SHA checks reject a changed checker or fixture.

The focused test reproduces all17 saved whole-family errors and11 cold/warm duplicate, numeric/reserved ID, pad-only bridge, via, empty/floating and source-order fixtures; changed native graph accessors retain original calls/reads/throw identity.

To reproduce the time-free census, extract replaySource to a temporary .ts file and run it with Bun and this repository root as its argument. It extracts the recorded native revision, applies both read-only instrumentation patches in temporary directories, and compares every per-trace field except the two removed enumeration counters.

Instrumentation counts component queries/members, per-trace pad adjacency and final filter work, and records original circuit-array indices and reference witnesses. It does not replace native globals, classes, memo methods or geometry queries.
